description: FastAPI plugin hooks — FastAPI/Pydantic/SQLAlchemy/Alembic version + project-layout detection at session start, an advisory guard on event-loop-blocking calls, hardcoded config secrets, wildcard CORS-with-credentials, and irreversible Alembic downgrades, and a shell guard that asks before destructive Alembic or database commands (FastAPI projects only).

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
